column1: # Groups of similar methods where one is unambiguously the canonical
# implementation, against a rails checkout. Proposed format — no harness reads
# this yet (see tests/eval/README.md).
# DRAFTED BY CLAUDE, NOT YET REVIEWED BY THE OWNER. Every verdict below was
# verified by reading both bodies and `git log` in the rails checkout, never
# assumed. Veto or amend any line.
# Format: canonical<TAB>alternate<TAB>evidence[<TAB>provisional]
# One row per (canonical, alternate) edge; a canonical with two alternates is
# two rows. `evidence` is comma-joined from a small vocabulary:
#   older       the canonical predates the alternate in git
#   delegates   the alternate calls the canonical (directly or via a shim)
#   mirrors     the alternate is a declared copy of the canonical (test stub)
#   ex_subclass the alternate's class once inherited the method's home
# escape_sql_comment (2021) re-implements what Quoting had since 2019, in the
# module the adapters already answer for.
ActiveRecord::ConnectionAdapters::Quoting#sanitize_as_sql_comment
# The REXML backend is the original (2008); the JDOM backend copied its merge
# helper when it was added (2009).
ActiveSupport::XmlMini_REXML#merge!
# register_type lived in TypeMap first (2014-05); HashLookupTypeMap — once a
# TypeMap subclass — gained its own copy when the two were decoupled for
# performance (2014-11).
ActiveRecord::Type::TypeMap#register_type
# The channel-test ConnectionStub (2021) copies the production identification
# helper (2015) so stubbed connections compute the same gid.
ActionCable::Connection::Identification#connection_gid
# The view helper is a documented shim: it calls delegate_number_helper_method
# and adds only the :raise option. The conversion logic lives in ActiveSupport.
ActiveSupport::NumberHelper#number_to_human_size
